name: What should be in a luxury home construction contract?

mainEntity.name: What contract details matter most in a high-end custom home project?
mainEntity.text: What contract details matter most in a high-end custom home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong contract is essential on any high-end project because luxury homes involve more variables than standard construction. The agreement should clearly state scope, finishes, allowances, exclusions, payment timing, change-order procedures, and schedule assumptions. It should also define who is responsible for design coordination, procurement, inspections, and owner approvals. If those items are vague, disputes become more likely once the project is underway. Homeowners should review whether selections, alternates, and contingency use are documented in a way that matches the project’s complexity. The contract should reflect how luxury work is actually managed, including custom items, long-lead purchases, and progress reporting. A clean contract does not remove all risk, but it makes the project much easier to run and much easier to control.
